w: In the evening while going for Thakorji's darshan, Swamishri blessed 290 tenth grade students for their final exams in March.

In the evening assembly, Swamishri eloquently narrated the story of how Tulsidas was inspired by his wife's words to concentrate on the highest goal of life (God). Swamishri then added, "Our concentration wavers during a spiritual discourse. If we listen with concentration then it will penetrate within and become fruitful. We do need to apply concentration in everything we do. A student has to concentrate while studying. Even in business one has to concentrate in order to get good results... "By listening to worldly talks our mind becomes disturbed and unhappy. However, by listening to God's divine episodes the soul experiences peace and happiness. And that was why Shriji Maharaj had instructed Muktanand Swami to write His incidents till the end of his life."
The murti of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by devotees.
The second day of the 3-day Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebrations. (News report)

st.t: Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebration - Ghela Arti
w: The Swaminarayan Mahamantra procession terminated at 6.30 pm by the banks of the river Unmat Ganga (Ghela). Here, Swamishri performed the pujan of Thakorji and the river Ghela, where Shriji Maharaj and 500 paramhansas and devotees had bathed and sanctified its waters. Then Swamishri and senior sadhus set afloat glowing lamps into the Ghela water and the sight of 5,222 divas floating in the river was spectacular and divine. Finally, Swamishri and the entire congregation performed the maha-arti of river Ghela, an occasion that was suffused with devotion and spiritual joy.

Swamishri blessed a youth for success in his business. Then he asked him about the state of his relation with his family. “O, everything is superb,” the youth replied enthusiastically. “Do you beat your wife?” Swamishri asked. The youth became quiet and ashamed. “Are you a satsangi?” “Yes.” “Then, is this what you learn in Satsang!” Then Swamishri advised him, “By living a married life you have to shoulder the responsibilities. Do not get angry. When you get irritated then chant ‘Swaminarayan, Swaminarayan...’. When you become angry during a row then simply leave the scene immediately. Make efforts not to get angry at all. Restrain your speech. Start reading satsang books and live according to the preachings of Satsang.” “Swami, bless me for peace of mind,” the youth prayed. “Peace lies within you. If you stop getting angry then you will have peace. By remaining quiet there will be peace. When someone is telling you off, you should be tolerant. Then there will be peace in your house.” Swamishri emphasized the need to integrate spiritual principles in life.

ds.t: Speak and listen to talk of glory
w: At the youth training centre in Sarangpur, many youths are receiving training in building their lives. In reply to a letter from one such seeker, Pramukh Swami Maharaj wrote: "Study properly at the training centre, and do whatever seva you get with an understanding of its glory. Win the pleasure of all the sadhus. Living together, understand the glory of everyone, do not see faults, see everyone's virtues, and speak and listen to talk of glory. Do the darshan and seva of Thakorji properly; do not be lazy. Listen to their talks so that your obedience to commands and upasana, your rules and dharma, and your love for spiritual discourse become especially firm. Understanding the glory of everyone, young and old, study well."

In the evening Pramukh Swami Maharaj was reading letters. Then the news came that Dr Madhubhai Desai, a devoted devotee originally from Thasra, had passed away. Swamishri had a call placed, and speaking with Madhubhai's son Kishorebhai and grandson Hetalbhai Desai, he said, "Madhubhai benefited greatly from Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj and did much seva, so he has gone straight to Akshardham. Our blessings are with you."

Two days earlier, when he was completely bedridden, Swamishri had blessed his son Dhavalbhai, who lives in Vadodara, on the phone and said, "Now Maharaj will take him to Akshardham." Then his family members became convinced that "now Father is going straight to Akshardham." And Dr Madhubhai himself told his son, "Now I am going to Akshardham, so let no one grieve. After I go, distribute sugar. When you perform the last rites of my body, play drums and throw abil and gulal (coloured powders)." And in exactly that way, with complete conviction in Swamishri's words, the whole family faithfully distributed sugar during the funeral procession before the cremation, threw abil and gulal and had drums played. When Swamishri received this news, he too was pleased.

In the evening Swamishri was reading letters. News came that Dr. Madhubhai Desai, a devoted satsangi originally from Thasra, had passed away. Swamishri had a call put through and, speaking with Madhubhai's son Kishorbhai and grandson Hetalbhai Desai, said, "Madhubhai received much benefit from Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj and did a great deal of seva, so he has taken his seat in God's abode. My blessings."

Two days earlier, when he was completely bedridden, Swamishri had blessed his son Dhavalbhai, who lives in Vadodara, on the phone and said, "Now Maharaj will take him to His abode." His family then felt sure that 'Bapuji is now going to God's abode.' And Dr. Madhubhai too told his son, "Now I will go to God's abode, so do not grieve. Hand out sugar after me. When you do the last rites for my body, play drums and throw abil and gulal (coloured powder)." And so the whole family, fully trusting Swamishri's word, faithfully handed out sugar in the funeral procession before the cremation, threw abil and gulal and had drums played. When Swamishri received this news, he too was pleased.
Before Mahant Swami Maharaj's breakfast, Brahmviharidas Swami told of an incident he had experienced:

"Two days earlier, on the 6th, he had to go to Delhi for an important meeting. Taking Swamishri's blessings, he reached there. The meeting ended successfully. Recalling a characteristic of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, he said to the sadhu with him, 'If Pramukh Swami Maharaj were here, a phone call would have come by now!' And just then Swamishri's phone call came!!"

Mentioning this incident, he said, "I was simply stunned. In a little while Swamishri phoned again: 'Have something sweet, and when you come, embrace me.' Then when I came to Ahmedabad, Swamishri embraced me of his own accord.
"Seeing the same knowledge of hearts and the same love, my conviction became firm that this is Swamibapa himself."

A short while ago a Yuvati Talim Kendra (young women's training centre) was started in Randesan. The young women who joined this centre had written prayers and sent them in a yagna kund (sacrificial fire pit) as a symbol of dedication.

They were brought to Mahant Swami Maharaj to be sanctified. Pointing towards Thakorji, Swamishri said, "First offer them to Thakorji." So the prayers were offered to Thakorji. Then Swamishri touched the prayers and sanctified them.
Swamishri has everything that comes to him offered first to Thakorji, whether it is an object or a prayer.
